title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files for review and approval a 365-Day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Hanscom Air Force Base.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing of the Agreement are Competitively sensitive, and therefore grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Judith F. Judson, Chairman, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul G. Afonso and Brian Paul Golden. (DTE 06-GC-8)
